athens.title: ATHENS week
athens.text: An intensive one-week course at one of 21 European partner universities, with classes and an exam. It counts towards your master.
athens.facts: 1 week · 30 hours of classes + exam · 3 credits · November or March

steps.title: How to apply
steps.register: Create an account on the ATHENS registration platform with your student.kuleuven.be address and fill in your details.
steps.choose: Choose at least three courses with a positive advice for your programme, and approve the Student Commitment.
steps.sign: Print your application, sign it and e-mail the scan to the faculty's ATHENS coordinator before the deadline. Submit it online too.
steps.selection: Your programme director approves your choices; then ParisTech assigns the courses at random. You get an e-mail with your course and the practical details.
steps.isp: Add H0V01A (Capita Selecta ATHENS I, November) or H0V02A (ATHENS II, March) to your ISP.

rules.title: Good to know
rules.once: You can take part once, during your master's.
rules.before: Only before a semester or year abroad, not after it.
rules.room: Your ISP must still have room for electives.
rules.retake: There is no resit. If you take it in your final year, you must pass to graduate.
rules.costs: No grant and no housing: count on €250 to €600 for the week, plus the fee for the European Dimension activities.
rules.cancel: Cancelling after the selection costs a cancellation fee.
